Interface CardDAO

All Known Implementing Classes:
ImplCardBD
public interface CardDAO
Data Access Object interface for Card entities.

Defines the contract for all card-related database operations, including CRUD operations, random card generation, and shop-related queries.

Author:
Brayan, Adam, Oihan and Asier

    • queryShopCards

      ArrayList<Card> queryShopCards(int playerId)
      Retrieves the list of cards available in the shop for a given player.

      If playerId is 0, returns a default set of random cards.

      Parameters:
      playerId - the ID of the player (0 for default/unauthenticated)
      Returns:
      an ArrayList of Card objects available in the shop
